# telnyx_enterprise_reputation_number_ownership (Data Source)

How Telnyx tracks the ownership of a monitored phone number: checks, flags and the deadline to confirm.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise.
- `phone_number` (String)

### Read-Only

- `baseline_carrier` (String) Service provider ID (SPID) of the carrier that held the number when its ownership was last established.
- `baseline_recorded_at` (String)
- `confirm_by` (String)
- `flag_reason` (String)
- `history` (Attributes List) Ownership events, most recent first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))
- `last_checked_at` (String) When ownership of the number was last checked.
- `ownership_status` (String) Result of ongoing ownership checks. `verified`: the number is with the carrier on record. `pending_confirmation`: the number's carrier changed, or a periodic ownership re-verification is due; confirm you still own it before `confirm_by`. `flagged`: a periodic re-verification went unanswered; the number stays monitored and is not removed, but confirm ownership (`POST .../ownership_confirm`) to return it to `verified`. `removed`: the number is no longer monitored; returned by `POST .../ownership_confirm` with `still_own: false`, and when listing numbers with `filter[ownership_status]=removed`.
- `source` (String) Where the phone number is hosted. `telnyx`: in your Telnyx inventory. `external`: a number you own that is hosted with another provider.

<a id="nestedatt--history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history`

Read-Only:

- `event_type` (String) `added`, `check`, `flag`, `confirm` or `removed`.
- `occurred_at` (String)
- `outcome` (String) What the event found or did, for example `unchanged` or `carrier_changed`.
